threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver shouts 'next stop' like it’s a friendly suggestion instead of a command.
Caught a late 77 to Crystal Palace last night. The driver was singing along to the radio like we were the only ones on the bus. Proper vibes.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I was in Tempelhofer Feld one sunny Sunday, watching families fly kites and people grill. That’s when it hit me: this place feels like a big, chaotic family reunion.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Friedrichshain has spontaneous street parties that turn into open-air galleries; artists showcase work on random walls while DJs spin from the back of vans.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their sigh when a streetcar is late; tourists just check their phones. We know the Muni's always running late, that's part of the charm.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a dog casually sunbathing on the tracks at Civic Center today. Muni staff just shrugged and waited. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just for parties, but many locals cherish the quiet afternoons in the hidden plazas, sipping café con leche undisturbed.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their oversized map and tendency to ask for directions to places that are just around the corner.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you’re new when you stare at the bus timetable like it’s a novel. Locals have already grabbed the next one without blinking.
Caught a night bus home from Brixton last week. The driver was having a right laugh with a group of mates, singing along to whatever was on the radio. Never seen that before!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids making a full-on marketplace with just a table and some old toys in Richardplatz. Such creativity in the air.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find an old factory turned into a rave venue — the vibe is electric but the walls tell stories of a time long past.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Someone from here knows to avoid the BART delays and will totally plan an evening around those 5 PM ‘overheating brakes’ announcements.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 today—packed, but the driver stopped to let a musician finish his song before moving. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are just for selfies, but locals see them as extensions of our living rooms, bustling with real conversations.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by the way they hesitate at the 'pancarta' signs in the plaça—like they’re deciding if it’s a festival or a protest.
